description: Le Bouddha énumère ses disciples les plus distingués et cite pour chacun d'eux la qualité qui leur vaut cette distinction.

body.pl: 188. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ rattaññūnaṃ yadidaṃ aññāsikoṇḍañño”.
body.fr: 188. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne l'ancienneté est Annyassikondanya (Vin I 12, SN 8.9, SN 56.11, Ud 7.6, Thg 673-688).

body.pl: 189. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mahāpaññānaṃ yadidaṃ sāriputto”.
body.fr: 189. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant un grand [panna|discernement] est Saripoutta.

body.pl: 190. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ iddhimantānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāmoggallāno”.
body.fr: 190. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant des [iddhi|pouvoirs psychiques] est Mahamoggallana.

body.pl: 191. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhutavādānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākassapo”.
body.fr: 191. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] préconisant les [dhuta|pratiques ascétiques] est Mahakassapa (MN 32, SN 6.5, SN 14.15, SN 16.2, SN 16.5-8, SN 16.10-13, SN 46.14, AN 10.86).

body.pl: 192. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ anuruddho”.
body.fr: 192. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant l'œil [deva|déva] est Anourouddha (SN 52, AN 8.30, AN 8.46, MN 11, MN 31-32, MN 68, MN 127-128, SN 6.5, SN 6.15, SN 9.6, SN 10.6, SN 14.15, SN 16.6, SN 37.5-17, SN 37.23-24, SN 47.26-28, AN 3.130-131, AN 4.243, Ud 1.5).

body.pl: 193. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uccākulikānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddiyo kāḷigodhāyaputto”.
body.fr: 193. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] étant d'une haute famille est Bhaddiya Kaligodhayapoutta (Thg 842–65).

body.pl: 194. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mañjussarānaṃ yadidaṃ lakuṇḍaka bhaddiyo”.
body.fr: 194. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant une voix douce est Lakoundaka Bhaddiya (SN 21.6, Ud 7.1, 7.2, 7.5, 7.10, Thg 466-472).

body.pl: 195. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sīhanādikānaṃ yadidaṃ piṇḍolabhāradvājo”.
body.fr: 195. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne le 'rugissement de lion' est Pindola Bharadvaja (SN 35.110, SN 48.49, Ud 4.6, Thg 123-124).

body.pl: 196. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ puṇṇo mantāṇiputto”.
body.fr: 196. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] orateurs sur le [dhamma|Dhamma] est Pounna Mantanipoutta (MN 24, MN 86, SN 22.83, Thg 4).

body.pl: 197. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saṃkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajantānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākaccāno”ti.
body.fr: 197. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne l'explication en détail de la signification de ce qui a été déclaré en bref est Mahakatchana (MN 18, 84, 133, 138, SN 22.3-4, 35.113, 35.115, AN 2.38-39, 6.26, 6.28, 10.26, 10.172, Ud 1.5, 5.6, 7.8).

body.pl: 198. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ manomayaṃ kāyaṃ abhinimminantānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako”.
body.fr: 198. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne la fabrication d'un [kaya|corps] par le [mana|mental] est Tchoulapanthaka (Vin IV 54).

body.pl: 199. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cetovivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ cūḷapanthako”.
body.fr: 199. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne l'habileté à transformer l'[citta|esprit] est Tchoulapanthaka.

body.pl: 200. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saññāvivaṭṭakusalānaṃ yadidaṃ mahāpanthako”.
body.fr: 200. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne l'habileté à transformer la [sanna|perception] est Mahapanthaka (Thg 510-517).

body.pl: 201. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ araṇavihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti”.
body.fr: 201. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] restant paisibles [en temps de conflit] est Soubhouti (AN 11.14, Ud 6.7, Thg 320-324).

body.pl: 202. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dakkhiṇeyyānaṃ yadidaṃ subhūti”.
body.fr: 202. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] dignes d'offrandes est Soubhouti.

body.pl: 203. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āraññakānaṃ yadidaṃ revato khadiravaniyo”.
body.fr: 203. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] séjournant en [aranna|forêt] est Révata Khadiravaniya (Thg 42).

body.pl: 204. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ yadidaṃ kaṅkhārevato”.
body.fr: 204. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] méditants est Kankharévata (MN 32, Ud 5.7, Thg 3).

body.pl: 205. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ āraddhavīriyānaṃ yadidaṃ soṇo koḷiviso”.
body.fr: 205. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] [araddhaviriya|énergiques] est Sona Kolivisa (AN 6.55, Thg 632-644).

body.pl: 206. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kalyāṇavākkaraṇānaṃ yadidaṃ soṇo kuṭikaṇṇo”.
body.fr: 206. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne les conversations [kalyana|bénéfiques] est Sona Koutikanna (Ud 5.6, Thg 365-369).

body.pl: 207. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ lābhīnaṃ yadidaṃ sīvali”.
body.fr: 207. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] acquérant [des offrandes] est Sivali (Ud 2.8, Thg 60).

body.pl: 208. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saddhādhimuttānaṃ yadidaṃ vakkalī”ti.
body.fr: 208. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] résolus par [saddha|conviction] est Vakkali (SN 22.87).

body.pl: 209. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhākāmānaṃ yadidaṃ rāhulo”.
body.fr: 209. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne le désir de l'[sikkha|entraînement] est Rahoula (SN 18, MN 61-62, MN 147, SN 22.91-92, SN 35.104, AN 4.177, Thg 295-298).

body.pl: 210. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ saddhāpabbajitānaṃ yadidaṃ raṭṭhapālo”.
body.fr: 210. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant [pabbaja|quitté la vie de foyer] par [saddha|conviction] est Ratthapala (MN 82, Thg 769-793).

body.pl: 211. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ salākaṃ gaṇhantānaṃ yadidaṃ kuṇḍadhāno”.
body.fr: 211. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] qui sont les premiers à prendre un ticket-repas est Koundadhano (Ud 2.8, Thg 15).

body.pl: 212. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭibhānavantānaṃ yadidaṃ vaṅgīso”.
body.fr: 212. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne le sens de la répartie est Vanguissa (SN 8, Sn 2.12, Sn 3.3, Thg 1218-1288).

body.pl: 213. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ samantapāsādikānaṃ yadidaṃ upaseno vaṅgantaputto”.
body.fr: 213. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] qui inspirent la confiance à tous est Oupaséna Vangantapoutta (SN 35.69, Ud 4.9-10, Thg 577-586).

body.pl: 214. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ senāsanapaññāpakānaṃ yadidaṃ dabbo mallaputto”.
body.fr: 214. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] qui attribuent les [senasana|gîtes] est Dabba fils de Malla (DN 16, Ud 8.9-10).

body.pl: 215. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ devatānaṃ piyamanāpānaṃ yadidaṃ pilindavaccho”.
body.fr: 215. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] agréables & plaisants aux [deva|dévas] est Pilindavaccha (Ud 3.6, Thg 9).

body.pl: 216. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ khippābhiññānaṃ yadidaṃ bāhiyo dārucīriyo”.
body.fr: 216. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en ce qui concerne la [abhinna|connaissance directe] rapide est Bahiya Daroutchiriya (Ud 1.10).

body.pl: 217. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cittakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ kumārakassapo”.
body.fr: 217. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] qui ont des mots d'[citta|esprit] est Koumarakassapa (MN 23, Thg 201-202).

body.pl: 218. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭisambhidāpattānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākoṭṭhito”ti.
body.fr: 218. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant atteint les connaissances analytiques est Mahakotthita.

body.pl: 219. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahussutānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando”.
body.fr: 219. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] [@m_bahussuta|très instruits] est Ananda.

body.pl: 220. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ satimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando”.
body.fr: 220. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant une bonne [sati|mémoire] est Ananda.

body.pl: 221. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ gatimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando”.
body.fr: 221. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en mémorisation est Ananda.

body.pl: 222. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhitimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando”.
body.fr: 222. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] résolus [à apprendre par cœur] est Ananda.

body.pl: 223. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ upaṭṭhākānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando”.
body.fr: 223. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant été assistants personnels est Ananda.

body.pl: 224. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ mahāparisānaṃ yadidaṃ uruvelakassapo”.
body.fr: 224. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] ayant une grande assemblée [de dévôts] est Ourouvélakassapa (Vin I 24).

body.pl: 225. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kulappasādakānaṃ yadidaṃ kāḷudāyī”.
body.fr: 225. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] inspirant la confiance aux familles est Kaloudayi (Thg 527-536).

body.pl: 226. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appābādhānaṃ yadidaṃ bākulo”.
body.fr: 226. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] en bonne santé est Bakoula (MN 124, Thg 225-227).

body.pl: 227. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantānaṃ yadidaṃ sobhito”.
body.fr: 227. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] [pnan|se remémorant leurs existences passées] est Sobhita (Thg 165-166).

body.pl: 228. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ upāli”.
body.fr: 228. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] connaissant par cœur la [vinaya|Discipline] est Oupali (AN 7.83, AN 10.31-38, 40-43, 99-100, Thg 249-251).

body.pl: 229. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunovādakānaṃ yadidaṃ nandako”.
body.fr: 229. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] exhortant les [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] est Nandaka (MN 146, AN 3.67, AN 9.4, Thg 173-174).

body.pl: 230. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ indriyesu guttadvārānaṃ yadidaṃ nando”.
body.fr: 230. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] [igdt|vigilants à l'entrée des facultés sensorielles] est Nanda (AN 8.9).

body.pl: 231. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhuovādakānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākappino”.
body.fr: 231. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] exhortant les [bhikkhu|mendiants] est Mahakappina (SN 6.5, SN 21.11-12, SN 54.7, Ud 1.5, Thg 547-556).

body.pl: 232. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ tejodhātukusalānaṃ yadidaṃ sāgato”.
body.fr: 232. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] habiles avec l'[dhatu|élément] feu est Sagata (Pc 51).

body.pl: 233. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭibhāneyyakānaṃ yadidaṃ rādho”.
body.fr: 233. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] [demandant et] recevant des discours éloquents est Radha (SN 22.71, SN 23, SN 35.59-61, Thg 133-134).

body.pl: 234. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ lūkhacīvaradharānaṃ yadidaṃ mogharājā”ti.
body.fr: 234. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhu|mendiants] portant des [civara|robes] frustes est Mogharaja (SN 1.34 Thg 207-208).

body.pl: 235. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ rattaññūnaṃ yadidaṃ mahāpajāpatigotamī”.
body.fr: 235. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] en ce qui concerne l'ancienneté est Mahapajapatigotami (MN 146, AN 8.51, 53, Thig 157-162).

body.pl: 236. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ mahāpaññānaṃ yadidaṃ khemā”.
body.fr: 236. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] ayant un grand [panna|discernement] est Khéma (SN 17.17, SN 44.1, AN 2.132, AN 4.176, Thig 139-144).

body.pl: 237. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ iddhimantīnaṃ yadidaṃ uppalavaṇṇā”.
body.fr: 237. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] ayant des [iddhi|pouvoirs psychiques] est Ouppalavanna (SN 5.5, AN 2.132, AN 4.176, Thig 224-235).

body.pl: 238. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ vinayadharānaṃ yadidaṃ paṭācārā”.
body.fr: 238. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] connaissant par cœur la [vinaya|Discipline] est Patatchara (Thg 112-116).

body.pl: 239. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadinnā”.
body.fr: 239. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] oratrices sur le [dhamma|Dhamma] est [dhamma|Dhamma]dina (MN 44, Thig 12).

body.pl: 240. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ jhāyīnaṃ yadidaṃ nandā”.
body.fr: 240. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] méditantes est Nanda.

body.pl: 241. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ āraddhavīriyānaṃ yadidaṃ soṇā”.
body.fr: 241. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] [araddhaviriya|énergiques] est Sona (Thig 102-106).

body.pl: 242. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ dibbacakkhukānaṃ yadidaṃ sakulā”.
body.fr: 242. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] ayant l'œil [deva|déva] est Sakoula (Thig 97-101).

body.pl: 243. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ khippābhiññānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddā kuṇḍalakesā”.
body.fr: 243. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] en ce qui concerne la [abhinna|connaissance directe] rapide est Bhadda Koundalakessa (Thig 107-111).

body.pl: 244. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarantīnaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddā kāpilānī”.
body.fr: 244. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] [pnan|se remémorant leurs existences passées] est Bhadda Kapilani (Thig 63-66).

body.pl: 245. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ mahābhiññappattānaṃ yadidaṃ bhaddakaccānā”.
body.fr: 245. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] ayant atteint une grande [abhinna|connaissance directe] est Bhaddakatchana.

body.pl: 246. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ lūkhacīvaradharānaṃ yadidaṃ kisāgotamī”.
body.fr: 246. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] portant des [civara|robes] frustes est Kissagotami (SN 5.3).

body.pl: 247. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ saddhādhimuttānaṃ yadidaṃ siṅgālakamātā”ti.
body.fr: 247. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] [bhikkhuni|mendiantes] résolues par [saddha|conviction] est Singalakamata.

body.pl: 248. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ paṭhamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchantānaṃ yadidaṃ tapussabhallikā vāṇijā”.
body.fr: 248. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], les plus distingués parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs étant allés en refuge les premiers sont les marchands Tapoussa et Bhallika (Vin I 4).

body.pl: 249. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ dāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ sudatto gahapati anāthapiṇḍiko”.
body.fr: 249. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs bienfaiteurs est le chef de foyer Soudatta, [aussi appelé] Anathapindika (SN 10.8, SN 55.27).

body.pl: 250. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ citto gahapati macchikāsaṇḍiko”.
body.fr: 250. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs prédicateurs du [dhamma|Dhamma] est le chef de foyer Tchitta de Matchikassanda (SN 41).

body.pl: 251. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ catūhi saṅgahavatthūhi parisaṃ saṅgaṇhantānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthako āḷavako”.
body.fr: 251. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs en ce qui concerne les quatre occasions de [pratiquer l']amabilité et le fait de sympathiser avec une assemblée est Hatthaka d'Alavi (AN 2.132, AN 3.35, AN 3.127, AN 4.176, AN 8.23, AN 8.24, SN 17.23).

body.pl: 252. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ paṇītadāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ mahānāmo sakko”.
body.fr: 252. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs qui donnent ce qui est excellent est Mahanama le Sakya (AN 3.73, AN 3.126, AN 6.10, AN 8.25, AN 11.11 & 12).

body.pl: 253. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ manāpadāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ uggo gahapati vesāliko”.
body.fr: 253. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs qui donnent ce qui est plaisant est le chef de foyer Ougga de Vessali (SN 35.107, AN 8.21, AN 5.44).

body.pl: 254. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ saṅghupaṭṭhākānaṃ yadidaṃ hatthigāmako uggato gahapati”.
body.fr: 254. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs assistant la [sangha|Communauté] est le chef de foyer Ouggata du village aux éléphants (SN 35.108, AN 8.22).

body.pl: 255. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ aveccappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ sūrambaṭṭho”.
body.fr: 255. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs ayant une [buddheaveccappasada|confiance confirmée] est Sourambattha (AN 6.127).

body.pl: 256. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ puggalappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ jīvako komārabhacco”.
body.fr: 256. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs faisant confiance aux personnes est Jivaka Komarabhatcha (DN 2, MN 55, AN 8.26, Vin I 268–81).

body.pl: 257. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ vissāsakānaṃ yadidaṃ nakulapitā gahapatī”ti.
body.fr: 257. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], le plus distingué parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïcs dignes de confiance est le chef de foyer Nakoulapita (SN 22.1, SN 35.114, AN 4.55, AN 6.16).

body.pl: 258. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṭhamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchantīnaṃ yadidaṃ sujātā seniyadhītā”.
body.fr: 258. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques étant allées en refuge les premières est Soujata la fille de Séniya (Vin I 15–18, SN 55.8?).

body.pl: 259. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ dāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ visākhā migāramātā”.
body.fr: 259. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques bienfaitrices est Vissakha la mère de Migara (AN 3.70, AN 8.43, AN 8.47, AN 8.49, Ud 8.8, Ud 2.9).

body.pl: 260. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ bahussutānaṃ yadidaṃ khujjuttarā”.
body.fr: 260. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques [@m_bahussuta|très instruites] est Khoujjoutara (SN 17.17, SN 17.24, AN 2.133, AN 4.176).

body.pl: 261. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ mettāvihārīnaṃ yadidaṃ sāmāvatī”.
body.fr: 261. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques demeurant dans la [metta|bienveillance] est Samavati (Ud 7.10, 79).

body.pl: 262. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ jhāyīnaṃ yadidaṃ uttarānandamātā”.
body.fr: 262. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques méditantes est Outtara la mère de Nanda (AN 7.53).

body.pl: 263. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā”.
body.fr: 263. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques qui donnent ce qui est excellent est Souppavasa la fille de Koliya (Ud 2.8 & 15–18, AN 4.57).

body.pl: 264. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ gilānupaṭṭhākīnaṃ yadidaṃ suppiyā upāsikā”.
body.fr: 264. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques assistant les malades est la disciple Souppiya (Vin I 216–18).

body.pl: 265. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ aveccappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ kātiyānī”.
body.fr: 265. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques ayant une [buddheaveccappasada|confiance confirmée] est Katiyani.

body.pl: 266. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ vissāsikānaṃ yadidaṃ nakulamātā gahapatānī”.
body.fr: 266. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques dignes de confiance est la maîtresse de maison Nakoulamata (AN 4.55, AN 6.16, AN 8.48).

body.pl: 267. “etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ anussavappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ kāḷī upāsikā kulagharikā”.
body.fr: 267. [bhikkhu|Mendiants], la plus distinguée parmi mes [savaka|disciples] laïques [gagnant] confiance par ce qu'elles entendent est la disciple Kali de Koulaghara (AN 10.26).
